title: Week of 30 October 2026
notes: New: the story of Prophet Idris, alayhis salaam, plus 21 gems on truthfulness and patience and 10 Jumu'ah quiz questions. Sources: the Qur'an (wording checked on quran.com), Sahih al-Bukhari 3207 (checked on sunnah.com) and Sahih Muslim 162 (checked through quran.com). abdurrahman.org could not be reached this week, so the story relies on the Qur'an and the two Sahihs only. The Qur'an says very little about Idris, so the story is short on events on purpose, and slide 3 says so. It does not say when he lived, since scholars differ on that. Please check the Arabic on slides 1, 4, 5 and 6 and the hadith numbers on the gems.

stories.title: Prophet Idris, the truthful one
stories.sub: Telling the truth, and being patient

sc.label: A quiet night sky full of stars over the sand

slides.text: Allah tells us about many Prophets in the Qur'an. One of them is Prophet Idris, alayhis salaam. Allah says:

ay.ar: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
ay.en: And mention Idris in the Book. He was a man of truth and a Prophet.

sc.label: A glowing lantern on the sand at night

slides.text: Allah called Idris siddiq. A siddiq is a person who is very, very truthful. What an amazing thing to be called by Allah!

sc.label: An open book with a soft light beside it

slides.text: The Qur'an tells us only a little about Idris. We believe everything Allah and His Messenger ﷺ tell us, and we do not make up stories about what they did not tell us.

sc.label: One bright star high in the evening sky

slides.text: Allah honoured Idris and gave him a very special place. Allah says:

ay.en: And We raised him to a high place.

sc.label: A calm desert under a warm sun

slides.text: Idris was also very patient. Allah names him together with two other Prophets, and says they were all patient:

ay.ar: وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّ مِّنَ الصَّابِرِينَ
ay.en: And Isma'il, Idris and Dhul-Kifl: all of them were patient.

sc.label: A peaceful garden with flowers in soft light

slides.text: Because of their patience and goodness, Allah gave them His mercy:

ay.ar: وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
ay.en: And We entered them into Our mercy. Truly, they were among the righteous.

sc.label: A deep night sky with a path of light going upward

slides.text: Long, long after Idris, Allah took Prophet Muhammad ﷺ up through the heavens in one night. This journey is called the Mi'raj.

sc.label: A shining sky high above the clouds

slides.text: In the fourth heaven, the Prophet ﷺ met Idris. Idris welcomed him, saying: Welcome, O brother and Prophet. And he made dua for him. (Sahih al-Bukhari 3207, Sahih Muslim 162)
We can try to be truthful like Idris. The Prophet ﷺ taught us that telling the truth leads to goodness, and goodness leads to Jannah. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6094, Sahih Muslim 2607)

sc.label: A glowing lantern beside an open Qur'an

slides.text: What do we learn? Always tell the truth, even when it is hard. Be patient. Believe what Allah and His Messenger ﷺ tell us, and don't add made-up stories. And Allah raises up the people who are truthful and patient.

quiz.q: What did Allah call Prophet Idris?
o: Siddiq, very truthful, and a Prophet
quiz.why: Allah says: He was a man of truth and a Prophet. (Maryam 19:56)

quiz.q: What did Allah do for Idris?
o: Raised him to a high place
quiz.why: And We raised him to a high place. (Maryam 19:57)

quiz.q: Which good quality did Idris share with Isma'il and Dhul-Kifl?
o: They all lived by the sea
quiz.why: Allah says: all of them were patient. (al-Anbiya 21:85)

quiz.q: Where did Prophet Muhammad ﷺ meet Idris on the night of the Mi'raj?
quiz.why: He met Idris in the fourth heaven, and Idris welcomed him.

gems.text: O you who believe, be mindful of Allah and say what is true and right.
gems.ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا

gems.text: O you who believe, be mindful of Allah and stay with the truthful people.
gems.ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَكُونُوا مَعَ الصَّادِقِينَ

gems.text: Ask Allah for help through patience and salah.
Be patient. Allah never lets the reward of good people be lost.
gems.ar: وَاصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

gems.text: Allah will give the patient people their reward without counting it.
By time! People are in loss, except those who believe, do good deeds, and remind each other of the truth and of patience.
Being clean is half of iman, and patience is a shining light.
How wonderful the believer is! When something good happens, he thanks Allah. When something hard happens, he is patient. Both are good for him.
Whoever tries to be patient, Allah makes him patient. No one is given a better and bigger gift than patience.
Never think any good deed is too small, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
A believer to another believer is like a building: each part holds the other up.
Whoever walks a path looking for knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Jannah.
If you plan a good deed and don't manage to do it, Allah still writes one good deed for you. If you do it, He writes ten or more.
Allah called two Prophets siddiq, very truthful: Prophet Ibrahim and Prophet Idris.
Prophet Isma'il always kept his promises. Allah praised him for it.
Allah said Prophets Isma'il, Idris and Dhul-Kifl were all patient.
On the night of the Mi'raj, Prophet Muhammad ﷺ met Prophet Idris in the fourth heaven.
Allah created seven heavens, one above the other.
Allah made the mountains like tent pegs that hold the earth steady.
Allah asks us to look at the camel and think about how wonderfully it was made.
The very first words of the Qur'an sent to the Prophet ﷺ were: Read in the name of your Lord who created.
gems.src: Surah al-'Alaq 96:1, Sahih al-Bukhari 3, Sahih Muslim 160

quiz.why: Allah called Idris siddiq: very, very truthful.

quiz.q: Which surah tells us that Idris was a man of truth and a Prophet?
Which two Prophets did Allah call siddiq in Surah Maryam?
What is the night journey up through the heavens called?
quiz.why: Allah took the Prophet ﷺ up through the heavens on the night of the Mi'raj.

quiz.q: Which Prophet always kept his promises?
quiz.why: Allah says Isma'il was true to his promise. (Maryam 19:54)

quiz.q: What two things help us, according to Surah al-Baqarah 2:45?
quiz.why: Seek help through patience and salah.

quiz.q: The Prophet ﷺ said patience is like what?
quiz.why: Patience is a shining light. (Sahih Muslim 223)

quiz.q: What is a good deed we should never think is too small?
o: Meeting people with a cheerful face
quiz.why: Even a cheerful face is a good deed. (Sahih Muslim 2626)

quiz.q: How many heavens did Allah create?
quiz.why: Allah created seven heavens, one above the other. (al-Mulk 67:3)

quiz.q: What were the first words of the Qur'an sent to the Prophet ﷺ?
o: Read in the name of your Lord
Say: He is Allah, the One
